entries.title: Preview as reviewer in portal loads the reviewer's Site again
entries.summary: **Preview as reviewer in portal** no longer ends in *Request Failed / Unable to load portal*. It opens the reviewer's Site, signed in as that reviewer.

where.path: Program → Review → Reviewers → Actions → Preview as reviewer in portal

entries.use_case: Support and organizers can see exactly what a reviewer sees while troubleshooting, without asking the reviewer for screenshots.

internal.when_to_bring_up: A customer or CSM reports that Preview as reviewer in portal showed Request Failed or Unable to load portal.
internal.who_should_get_it: Any customer that previews reviewers' Sites while troubleshooting.
internal.staff_path: Program → Review → Reviewers → Actions → Preview as reviewer in portal

entries.title: Sites keep working when the page is translated in the browser
entries.summary: Reviewers and applicants who use their browser's translate feature (for example Chrome Translate) no longer see *An error occurred while loading the App section* on every click. Sites now keep working when the page is translated.
entries.use_case: Reviewers whose language the Site doesn't offer can translate the page and finish their reviews.

internal.when_to_bring_up: A reviewer or applicant reports an error loading a section after translating the page in their browser.
internal.who_should_get_it: Events with reviewers or applicants whose language the Site does not offer.
internal.staff_path: Open the event's Site in a browser with page translation turned on

entries.title: Custom roles get a Restrict records switch, and Contact access is open to every event admin
entries.summary: Create Role and Edit Role now have a **Restrict records** switch for custom roles. Members of a role with it on get session filters and **Contact access** when you invite or edit them. **Contact access** is now visible to every event admin, not only Sessionboard staff.

where.path: Event Settings → Team → Roles & permissions (Create Role / Edit Role) and Event Settings → Team (invite or edit a member)

entries.use_case: Give a vendor or outside team a custom role that only sees the sessions and contacts you pick, without duplicating Session Manager first, and set the contact limits yourself instead of asking Sessionboard staff.

cs_action.note: Self-serve for every event admin; nothing to turn on. Default roles do not show the switch.

internal.when_to_bring_up: A customer wants a vendor or external team to see only certain sessions or contacts, or asks why Contact access was not on their invite screen.
internal.who_should_get_it: Any customer using custom roles with limited record access, especially those with vendor or external-staff roles (e.g. Tahaluf ME event 2).
internal.staff_path: Event Settings → Team → Roles & permissions → Create Role or Edit Role
internal.gotchas: Switching Restrict records on an existing role applies to everyone who already holds it as soon as the role is saved. Default roles cannot be changed.
internal.talk_track: You can now control record restrictions directly on any custom role — no need to duplicate a built-in role. And every admin on your team can see and configure Contact access filters when inviting or editing a member.

entries.title: Sending a contract via DocuSign no longer fails when the template has no signer role
entries.summary: **Send via Docusign** no longer fails with an error when the Docusign template has no signer role. The envelope goes out to the signer you picked. If the template no longer exists in Docusign, you now see a clear message to check it and try again.

where.path: Contacts → [contact record] → Contracts → Send via DocuSign

entries.use_case: A CSM can tell a customer whose Docusign template was built without a named signer role that sending works now, and that a deleted template shows a plain message instead of a failure.

internal.when_to_bring_up: A customer reports that sending a DocuSign contract returns an error or that no contract row was created after clicking Send.
internal.who_should_get_it: Any customer using the DocuSign integration with templates that have no named signer role.
internal.staff_path: Contacts → [contact record] → Contracts → Send via DocuSign
internal.gotchas: Templates with several named signer roles still send to the first one by routing order.
internal.talk_track: DocuSign templates that lacked a named signer role used to cause a 500 error and no contract record was saved. That is now fixed — Sessionboard falls back to a composite template so the envelope still goes out.
